description: Use when the user needs to know whether a trend is substantive or hype before acting on it. Returns, year by year, the share of 10-K filers mentioning it (SEC EDGAR), of federal final and proposed rules (Federal Register) and of federal contract obligations (USAspending), each line's direction, and whether the three agree. If any source fails its controls the whole run refuses. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: three shares by year (start-end). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For one source over a custom window, use run_filing_trend, run_regulatory_trend or run_spend_trend. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/triangulation.json
